text: Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Limited, the company behind the Tameeni insurance-comparison platform, is wholly owned by Rasan Information Technology Company, the Saudi fintech group listed on the Saudi Exchange since May 2024.
short: Tameeni is wholly owned by listed Rasan Information Technology.

source.name: Capital Market Authority (Saudi Arabia): Rasan Information Technology IPO prospectus, subsidiaries table
source.quote: with a capital of five hundred thousand Saudi Riyals (SAR 500,000), wholly owned by the Company (hereinafter referred to as Tameeni Company)
source.note: PDF; the line sits in the subsidiaries list under '2- Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage Limited'.

additionalSources.name: Rasan: IPO page
additionalSources.quote: providing seamless services through our flagship subsidiaries, including Tameeni
additionalSources.note: Rasan describes Tameeni as one of its subsidiaries. Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03.
